commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' The free kick is delivered by Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye (Burnley) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
90+6' A clumsy foul by Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle. Burnley get a free kick.
90+5' A corner kick by Tottenham is thwarted by the well prepared Arijanet Muric (Burnley).
90+4' Tottenham work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+4' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Tottenham.
90+2' Vincent Kompany is stunned as referee Jarred Gillett shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
90+1' Lorenz Assignon (Burnley) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
88' Here comes a substitution. Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) is brought on as a substitute for Pape Matar Sarr.
88' The referee allows time for a substitution. James Maddison will be replaced by Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham).
88' Vincent Kompany has decided to substitute Josh Cullen and he is replaced by Zeki Amdouni (Burnley).
88' The referee signals a substitution. David Datro Fofana (Burnley) is brought on as a substitute for Lyle Foster.
87' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham).
87' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

86' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the left side of the goal is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper. The ball is out of play. Tottenham will have a chance to score from a corner.
86' James Maddison (Tottenham) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

85' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. Tottenham win a corner kick.
84' The attendance for today's match is 61148.

82' 2 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from James Maddison, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Micky van de Ven (Tottenham), who beats Arijanet Muric with a brilliant shot into the left side of the net. 2:1.
81' That will be all from Jacob Bruun Larsen who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye (Burnley).

80' Arijanet Muric pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) fired on target after a rebound. His effort from inside the box flew straight towards the right post, but was stopped by the goalkeeper.
78' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) missed a big chance! He produces a stunning volley from inside the box, but his effort goes not far wide of the right post.
78' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Arijanet Muric, who smothers the ball.
76' A pass from Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) is intercepted by Arijanet Muric and the move breaks down.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Dane Scarlett (Tottenham) will replace Dejan Kulusevski.
75' Ange Postecoglou prepares a substitution. Yves Bissouma is replaced by Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham).
75' Ange Postecoglou has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Radu Dragusin (Tottenham) replacing Oliver Skipp.
73' Benson Manuel Hedilazio (Burnley) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vitinho trots off the pitch and is replaced by Benson Manuel Hedilazio (Burnley).
72' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) darts into the box and immediately fires a first-time effort that ends well wide of the right post.
68' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) produces a good strike that sails towards the left post, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
67' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) is yellow-carded.

66' What a save from Arijanet Muric! Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
65' A yellow card is awarded to Sander Berge (Burnley).
62' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
58' Burnley have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

57' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his shot towards the top of the goal, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it. Burnley force a corner. They send men into the box.
55' Oliver Skipp (Tottenham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jarred Gillett had an easy-decision to make.
54' Chance! Pedro Porro (Tottenham) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Heung-Min Son, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the right post.
54' James Maddison (Tottenham) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
53' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
51' The resulting corner, taken by James Maddison (Tottenham), comes to nothing.

51' This shall not pass! Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. The linesman makes the right call and Tottenham will have a corner.
50' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
47' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! James Maddison (Tottenham) gets booked.
46' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Charlie Taylor (Burnley) receives a yellow card!
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the bottom right corner. Guglielmo Vicario is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
43' The corner by James Maddison (Tottenham) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
43' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball goes out of play. Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.
41' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Lyle Foster (Burnley) heads on.
40' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
40' The ball is cleared after Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The linesman points to the corner flag, Burnley are going to take it.
38' James Maddison (Tottenham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Arijanet Muric intercepts the ball.
36' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
34' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the right of the target.
34' Wilson Odobert sprays a pass out to Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes well wide of the left post.
32' 1 - 1 Goal! Brennan Johnson tees up Pedro Porro (Tottenham) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the roof of the net. 1:1.
29' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
28' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) sends a cross into the box, but Arijanet Muric comes off his line to gather the ball.
25' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Sander Berge laid the ball off to Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley), who shot from close range into the bottom left corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
24' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.

22' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Arijanet Muric was alert and the score remains the same.
22' A pass from Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is intercepted by Arijanet Muric and the move breaks down.
21' Vitinho (Burnley) tries to find Lyle Foster, but he puts too much power on the through ball.

19' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
16' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
15' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
11' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Josh Cullen (Burnley) is given a yellow card.
9' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is penalised for a foul. Jarred Gillett had a clear view and blows his whistle.
8' The ball is whipped in from the corner by James Maddison (Tottenham), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

7' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the right post. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper dives to make a stunning save. Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick.
6' Burnley take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

5' What a save from Guglielmo Vicario! Vitinho (Burnley) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out. Burnley force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
5' Tottenham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

4' That's unlucky! James Maddison (Tottenham) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. Tottenham earn a corner.
2' Josh Cullen (Burnley) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
